==Description==
'''Hardcore Live Event''' was a live event held for the release of the long awaited [[Hardcore Testing BETA|Hardcore Update]]. However, due to the disastrous launch of that update, it would be turned into a public test for the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]] instead.

It released on the 28th of August 2020, though it was originally meant to release on the 21st of August 2020.

==Live Event==
[[File:FULL LIVE EVENT AND NEW LOBBY in TOWER DEFENSE SIMULATOR - Roblox|200px|thumb]]
There was a purple door with an eye in the lobby that had a timer on it. After the timer hit 00:00:00, the live event would start. It began with the screen going black, music changing to [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DIp4Yl69xlA Ticking], with the following text being displayed:
:"''...''"
:"''I feel it.. the end..''"
:"''[???]: The end is only the beginning''"
After this, the screen would return to normal and the skybox in the lobby would change. Purple orbs would begin to fall from the sky, with the goal being to avoid them for 1 minute and 30 seconds. No matter if the player survived or not, an animation would play after 1 minute and 30 seconds, where spinning purple light would come out of the eye in the door, and shortly after other parts of the turn would turn neon purple. The eye would then become a black hole that pulled in multiple parts of the lobby and players. After this the screen would turn black and everyone would be kicked from the server. The only reward was a [[Badges|badge]] given for participating in this live event, however, not everyone actually received it due to bugs.
